newsitem.title: USA: Oilgear forms joint venture in India.
newsitem.headline: Oilgear forms joint venture in India.

text.p: Oilgear Co said Thursday it formed a new joint venture company in India with Harman Engineers, an Indian automation and process controls manufacturer.
The venture, Harman Oilgear Pvt Ltd of Bangalor, India, will design, manufacture and market a line of process automation system applications.
Oilgear will have a 51 percent interest in the joint venture, which marks the company's entry into material handling, food processing and energy management applications.
Harman Oilgear is the second joint venture established in India by Oilgear. The first, Oilgear Towler Polyhydron Pvt Ltd, was formed in 1994.
